title: E-Commerce Competitor Price & Stock Monitor Input

productUrls.title: Competitor Product URLs
productUrls.description: List of competitor e-commerce product URLs to monitor (supports Shopify /products/* URLs and any store with Schema.org Product/Offer JSON-LD).

ourBaselinePrice.title: Our Baseline Price
ourBaselinePrice.description: Your baseline product price for calculating price difference (priceDiff and priceDiffPercent) against each competitor product.

geminiApiKey.title: Gemini API Key (Optional - BYOK)
geminiApiKey.description: Google Gemini API key for AI merchandising proposals and Slack alert generation. Falls back to GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable if omitted.

geminiModel.title: Gemini Model Override (Optional)
geminiModel.description: Optional Gemini model name override (defaults to gemini-2.5-flash with automatic fallback discovery).
